notes.title: MEAT MADNESS: FLESHED OUT
notes.content:
We've been thrilled by the support that this project has gotten in the past two months.

And now, we're happy to announce that we've just released a complete overhaul update for Meat Madness with a horrifying new story to experience, chilling new levels to explore, many QoL improvements, and some strange secrets for you to find along the way.
